lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Ahhhg, they forgot to leave it raised.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Another security system of yours?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text:
Not really.
When we moved in we started building better routes to the station.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Helenna built a drawbridge so the fishermen could still get through.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: How considerate.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Not my idea. Let's raise it. The switch is in the storehouse.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: How about swimming across? I could use the bath.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: I got no intention of jumping into a river.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Right, wouldn't want to wash away the bitterness.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Very funny.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Huh… it's a bit…

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Rundown?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Yeah… I remember it being in a bit better condition.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Of course… the gate is closed.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: It's a similar mechanism to my gate, but with a timer'.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Meaning?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: We need to keep both power sources on and get through quickly.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Really? Why did you two make everything so complicated

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: So, now what?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: I told you, Rex can be great help.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Are you crazy!?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Rex.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Woof woof!

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: But… he could have gotten hurt?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Rex is also enhanced, he can take it

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Even the dog? a very normal couple you two.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: It's a long story.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Great, the rope bridge broke down.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Hmm… how much weight can your arm take?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I've got an idea. Just hold on to that anchor and I'll zipline across.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Madness.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I'm serious! It can work.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: I'll do it, but be careful brat. Not excited to see you plummet to the ground.
